name: Vera
source:
A bounty hunter by trade, Vera is no stranger to tracking down people and uncovering their secrets. 
This time around, after an attack on her ship that leaves her with memory loss, Vera must discover her own. 

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/hmoon/day-after-day-otome-narrative-rpg?ref=recommendation-projectpage-footer-3&category_id=Q2F0ZWdvcnktMzU=]Kickstarter[/url]]
